title: Plasma Computer Power and Cooling (Signature) — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Mirrors its public twin record: Drive power ionizes, fields confine, waves compute — the power budget rules all. The Signature extension treats power as a scheduled resource: the operating system rations watts to regions by workload, idling cold regions at minimum sustain power. This is a Signature-concept extension (speculative): it is an original design proposal for the JAH system, never presented as established physics.
